question: Gotham servicing subsidy calculation; contract benchmarks; whether loan gain premium is economically justified
conclusion: Gotham numerical inference fails. Low published CVNA ABS base fees are real, but external backup-servicer contracts substantially weaken an inference that only a related party could supply such pricing. Private fixed-pool and Ally numerical servicing terms remain unresolved. Elevated blended gain ratios are not independently validated by this finding.

errors: Annual servicing revenue spans existing vintages; annual sales are not average serviced balances.
8888 residual subtracts annual sales and point-in-time held balances from year-end third-party serviced stock.
Five-year flat original balance ignores amortization, prepayment, defaults and discounting; compares all-vintage portfolio to one year new-sale gains.
Narrative invokes 2.224%-2.903% benchmarks but 666.6-888.8m table uses 1.5%-2%; those are gross assumed fees, not net shortfall after actual fees.
Gain on sale is not by definition price minus fair value; usual basis bridge includes carrying value, consideration, retained interests and expenses.

new_contract_evidence.finding: Signed contract differs from prospectus summary suggesting same successor fee. Use signed agreement. Vervent successor exempt from predecessor obligations and specified Actual Loss Amount indemnification; supplements and liquidation reimbursements additional.
Vervent agrees to assume during appointment period; transition/boarding expenses and indemnities reimbursable. Standby fee ceases on assumption. Not a clean all-in standalone market quote.

new_contract_evidence.limit: Ally servicing own ABS, NOT Bridgecrest fee on Ally-owned CVNA loans

new_contract_evidence.locator: Transaction Fees and Expenses pp83, Servicing Compensation p96
new_contract_evidence.limit: Riskier pool; supplemental fees and liquidation costs matter

new_contract_evidence.locator: Servicing Fee summary and Transaction Fees

economic_interpretation.abs_2026_p3: 1% strip = .39% base plus .61% XS cash flow, before supplemental fees and expenses. XS may be privately sold or retained. Trace ownership and sale consideration before attributing full value to CVNA; ordinary note coupons do not capture whole financing economics.

illustrative_fee_pv_only.limit: Not measured duration, fair fee, subsidy or amount captured by CVNA. Not all channels have same terms.

economic_interpretation.gain_peer: CarMax FY26 sale 930m including accrued interest, gain26.9m net transaction expense =2.8925%; recent596m/16.6m =2.7852%. CVNAQ3 blended7.3981%. Not normalized for risk, age, retained servicing, basis, capital and sale structure.

search_limits: Broader SEC, issuer prospectus, rating and contract-mirror discovery. Full Ally Master Servicing Agreement numerical rate and fixed-pool fee schedules not recovered. Nicholas-Westlake portfolio disposal rejected as fresh-originations gain comparator; generic Santander search not a valid normalized gain benchmark. No paid data or outreach.
decision_use: Exclude Gotham 667-889m estimate as unsupported. Use signed servicing rates for identified pools and scenario sensitivities. Do not extrapolate private-buyer subsidy=0 or justify return to 9-10% blended gains without buyer economics and matched realized loss/prepayment data.
